props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: backdropStyle
props.description:
Style applied to the full-screen backdrop wrapper. No defaults — pass
`backgroundColor`, alignment, etc. here for the modal dim/centering.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
controlling transition with Vue native transition or other animation
libraries.

props.name: trapFocus
props.description:
When `true`, focus cannot escape the `Content`. No-op on Lynx (there is
no focus trap); no-op on Lynx because there is no DOM focus trap.
